! Arista EOS sample configuration - MLAG Leaf Switch
! Model: DCS-7050SX3-48YC8
! Version: 4.27.3M
hostname leaf01
version 4.27.3M

!
! Management
!
interface Management1
   description Management interface
   ip address 192.168.1.101/24
   no shutdown

!
! VLAN definitions
!
vlan 10
   name Users
   state active

vlan 20
   name Servers
   state active

vlan 30
   name DMZ
   state active

vlan 100
   name MLAG-Peer
   state active

vlan 200
   name Native

vlan 3000
   name VXLAN-L2

!
! VLAN interfaces (SVIs)
!
interface Vlan10
   description Users gateway
   ip address 10.0.10.1/24
   no shutdown

interface Vlan20
   description Servers gateway
   ip address 10.0.20.1/24
   no shutdown

interface Vlan100
   description MLAG peer keepalive
   ip address 10.255.255.1/30
   no shutdown

!
! Physical interfaces
!
interface Ethernet1
   description PoC-to-dist01
   switchport mode trunk
   switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,100
   switchport trunk native vlan 200
   channel-group 1 mode active
   no shutdown

interface Ethernet2
   description PoC-to-dist02
   switchport mode trunk
   switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,100
   switchport trunk native vlan 200
   channel-group 1 mode active
   no shutdown

interface Ethernet3
   description server-rack1-port01
   switchport mode access
   switchport access vlan 10
   spanning-tree portfast
   no shutdown

interface Ethernet4
   description server-rack1-port02
   switchport mode access
   switchport access vlan 20
   spanning-tree portfast
   no shutdown

interface Ethernet5
   description server-rack2-port01
   switchport mode trunk
   switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20
   no shutdown

interface Ethernet6
   description server-rack2-port02
   switchport mode access
   switchport access vlan 10
   spanning-tree portfast
   storm-control broadcast level 10
   no shutdown

interface Ethernet7
   unused-port
   shutdown

interface Ethernet48
   description peer-link-to-leaf02
   switchport mode trunk
   switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30
   channel-group 1000 mode active
   no shutdown

interface Ethernet49
   description peer-link2-to-leaf02
   switchport mode trunk
   switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30
   channel-group 1000 mode active
   no shutdown

!
! Port-Channels
!
interface Port-Channel1
   description LAG-to-dist
   switchport mode trunk
   switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,100
   switchport trunk native vlan 200
   no shutdown

interface Port-Channel1000
   description MLAG peer-link
   switchport mode trunk
   switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30
   no shutdown

!
! MLAG configuration
!
mlag configuration
   domain-id MLAG-DOMAIN-01
   local-interface Vlan100
   peer-address 10.255.255.2
   peer-link Port-Channel1000
   heartbeat-interval 5000
   reload-delay 300
   no shutdown

!
! VXLAN
!
interface Vxlan1
   description VXLAN overlay
   vxlan source-interface Loopback0
   vxlan vlan 10 vni 10010
   vxlan vlan 20 vni 10020
   vxlan vlan 30 vni 10030
   vxlan flood vtep 10.0.0.1 10.0.0.2
   vxlan learn from arp

!
! Static routes
!
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 192.168.1.1
ip route 10.0.0.0/8 192.168.1.254 name dc-core
ip route 172.16.0.0/16 10.255.255.2 tag 100

!
! OSPF
!
router ospf 100
   router-id 10.0.0.101
   network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.255 area 0.0.0.0
   network 10.255.255.0 0.0.0.3 area 0.0.0.0
   network 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 area 0.0.0.10
   passive-interface default
   no passive-interface Vlan100

!
! BGP
!
router bgp 65001
   router-id 10.0.0.101
   maximum-paths 4
   neighbor 10.0.0.1 remote-as 65000
   neighbor 10.0.0.1 description spine-01
   neighbor 10.0.0.2 remote-as 65000
   neighbor 10.0.0.2 description spine-02
   network 10.0.10.0/24
   network 10.0.20.0/24
   vrf TENANT-A
      rd 65001:100
      neighbor 10.0.10.1 remote-as 65001
      neighbor 10.0.10.1 update-source Vlan10

!
! Access-lists
!
ip access-list MGMT-ACL
   10 permit ip 192.168.0.0/24 any
   20 permit ip 10.0.0.0/8 any
   999 deny ip any any log

ip access-list SSH-ONLY
   10 permit tcp any any eq 22
   20 deny ip any any

!
! VRF instances
!
vrf instance TENANT-A
   rd 65001:100
   route-target import 65001:100
   route-target export 65001:100

vrf instance TENANT-B
   rd 65001:200
   route-target import 65001:200
   route-target export 65001:200
